comparablesFor.title: Find comparables for these listings
comparablesFor.description: Give one listing URL. The actor scrapes it, derives a search from its own characteristics (type, district, price ±15%, surface ±20%) and returns the closest comparable listings alongside it.

startUrls.title: Listing URLs (detail only)
startUrls.description: Scrape these listing detail pages and stop. No comparables search.

searchUrls.title: Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Run a SeLoger /classified-search URL you built yourself and return every result card.

maxComparables.title: Max comparables
maxComparables.description: Upper bound on comparables returned per subject. Fewer are returned when the area is thin — that is normal, not an error.

priceTolerance.title: Price tolerance
priceTolerance.description: How far a comparable may differ in price. 0.15 = ±15%.

surfaceTolerance.title: Surface tolerance
surfaceTolerance.description: How far a comparable may differ in living area. 0.20 = ±20%.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: SeLoger is protected by DataDome. Residential proxies are strongly recommended — datacenter IPs get challenged within a handful of requests.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Keep this low. SeLoger flags bursts of parallel requests from the same subnet.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max retries per URL
maxRequestRetries.description: Each retry gets a fresh proxy IP and browser fingerprint.

headless.title: Run headless
headless.description: Turn off only when debugging locally.
